title: The hidden agent running every single Kubernetes node
caption: Kubelet is the unsung hero of Kubernetes worker nodes. Have you ever had a node flip to NotReady?

scenes.vo: Kubernetes control plane never starts containers directly. Every worker node runs an unsung hero called kubelet to do the dirty work.
scenes.heading: KUBELET

scenes.vo: Think of kubelet like an on-site foreman. Headquarters sends blueprints, and the foreman makes sure the job gets done.
scenes.heading: THE FOREMAN
scenes.line: AN ON-SITE FOREMAN FOR YOUR PODS

scenes.vo: Kubelet fetches Pod specs from the API server, orders the container runtime to start them, and continuously checks their health.
scenes.heading: HOW IT WORKS

scenes.vo: If kubelet crashes, the node flips to NotReady. The containers might still run, but Kubernetes goes completely blind.
scenes.heading: KUBELET CRASHES

scenes.vo: When a node drops offline, don't guess. Check the kubelet service directly on the host using systemctl.
scenes.heading: CHECK KUBELET

scenes.vo: So kubelet: the node agent, the pod builder, and your node heartbeat. Follow for more Kubernetes made simple.
scenes.heading: KUBELET
